scope: evidence-first audit after v0.1.1 convergence; no tag/push/release mutation; no CI metadata rewrite without reproduced defect

publisher_requires: Android CI workflow conclusion success for a push
version-matched tag at the exact tested SHA
successful same-SHA Android E2E Conformance push
GitHub Release for the tag must not already exist

hosted_state.assessment: The automatic release publisher is correctly fail-closed under the declared contract. Current hosted failures are in screenshot/E2E qualification tiers, not APK build/package metadata.

overridden_gates: Android E2E Conformance run 35383205247 concluded failure
Android CI screenshot job in run 35383205223 was in progress at publication

local_artifact.assessment: valid sideload/development release artifact; not store-production signing; dirty worktree means it is not the canonical published artifact

release_variant_security.assessment: appropriate for sideload review only; production-store signing and a stricter backup policy remain separate hardening concerns

offline_download_store.assessment: no versioned migration boundary is declared for the Java Properties store

fresh_test_attempt.first_attempt: failed before tests because the shared Gradle cache could not create dependency directories
fresh_test_attempt.isolated_cache_attempt: Gradle wrapper distribution download was too slow and was interrupted; no product-test failure was observed

tgtext.assessment: Both the published v0.1.3 APK and current local release APK fit the active default 50 MiB tgtext document ceiling. Prefer the published asset for canonical delivery because the worktree is dirty.
